capabilities: Create book, volume, and chapter folder structures from Markdown templates
Draft, continue, rewrite, polish, and review chapters via LLM commands
Chat with a dockable panel that can quote any vault file via @references
Visualize character relationships and merged timelines in side panels
Count words per chapter or book and export the exact AI prompts per feature
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is for novel writing (books, volumes, chapters), not articles or essays.
extras: Carries extensive security and privacy disclosures (network requests, base64 usage, vault enumeration scopes). UI, commands, and generated documents are largely in Chinese; a built-in usage guide (《使用说明.md》) is auto-written into the work folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure or AI workflow for long-form fiction, where a book needs volumes, chapters, outlines, characters, and consistent story state across many files.

relations.evidence: All outbound traffic goes exclusively through the official openai SDK to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint
relations.plugin: OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, DeepSeek, Qwen DashScope)

requires.name: API key for a hosted provider (DeepSeek, Qwen DashScope)
Local LLM server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp)

summary: AI-assisted novel-writing toolkit that organizes each story as a folder of Markdown files and adds LLM commands for drafting, polishing, and reviewing chapters.
